title: Between-the-Legs Walk Series
description: Players walk the length of the court taking a between-the-legs dribble on every step, building rhythm and a protected change of hands.

content.objective: Pass the ball between the legs in rhythm with the footwork, so the change of hands is protected by the body.
content.setup: Players on the baseline with a ball each, spaced along it.
content.organization: Everyone walks the court together, then jogs back on the return.
instructions: Step forward with the left foot and bounce the ball between the legs from right hand to left.
Step with the right foot and bounce it back from left to right.
Keep walking the length of the court, one between-the-legs per step.
On the way back, walk backwards doing the same move.
Finish with a stationary set of 20 fast between-the-legs in a wide stance.
coachingPoints: Bounce the ball under the middle of the body, not off to the side.
Front foot steps, then the ball goes through.
Hips low, chest up, eyes forward.
commonMistakes: Hitting the leg because the stance is too narrow.
content.safety: Players walk in separate lanes; a ball that escapes is retrieved only when the lane is clear.
progressions: Jog the series instead of walking.
Add a crossover after every second between-the-legs.
regressions: Stationary only, in a wide stance.
Allow a pause between each change.
variations: Combine with a behind-the-back on the return trip.
Partners race, losing a step for every bobble.
successCriteria: Walks the full court without the ball hitting a leg.
Rhythm matches the footwork every step.
content.gameApplication: The between-the-legs change keeps the body between the defender and the ball while changing hands in traffic.
